Some recommendations expected to clash with those of Milburn’s recent report into Neets

  • UK disability benefit cuts ‘risk worsening youth destitution’

The Tory event coincided with Nigel Farage, the Reform UK leader, giving a speech. He used it to claim that Andy Burnham had no mandate for his EU reset, that the deal agreed on Friday would be bad for farmers, that Reform UK was still “the Brexit party” and that, even though people felt let down by how Brexit had been implemented, that did not mean they would vote to rejoin.

He also claimed the Conservative party was dominated by people who voted remain.

If you want to believe it’s a new Conservative party, that is entirely up to you.

I would put it to you that the Conservative party now is utterly dominated by those who believed in remain and did so in many cases years after the referendum vote, and they’re now masquerading as being pro-Brexit.

Prison works, but we need the capacity to make sure more criminals are locked up.

Labour have failed to build prison places, instead cutting corners and letting criminals out early. The message to every criminal in the country is that the odds are in their favour.
